items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Now, I used to call him Doug. He was the lead of this band.

ctx.x: Well, who was some of the outstanding men on those bands? I mean, yeah. Well, I don't know.
One boy, I was 50 feet. Now, I used to call him Doug. He was the lead of this band. Oh, yeah, they had, what you call them little things?
Is it kind of like a guitar? Yeah. Mandolin?
